title: Recent Progress for Single-Molecule Magnets Based on Rare Earth Elements
claim: Even very weak intermolecular magnetic exchange can suppress quantum tunneling and improve Ln-SMM performance, despite 4f electrons being shielded.
explanation: The authors state that magnetic exchange is an important performance factor and that early studies showed weak intermolecular exchange can suppress QTM. They add that 4f-4f exchange remains relatively weak because of outer-electron shielding but still significantly affects SMM properties.
scope: Rare-earth SMMs, discussed in the double-decker Pc section and again for polymers and clusters.
caveats: No quantitative exchange threshold is given; the effect is described as weak but consequential, not as a design that always raises TB.
